about:
# WoW Addons by Lurx

| Addon | What it does |
|---|---|
| [One-Click Mount](https://github.com/lurx/wow-addons/blob/main/one-click-mount) | One action bar button that picks the right mount or movement spell for where you are. |
| [Lueur (retail port)](https://github.com/lurx/wow-addons/blob/main/lueur) | Unofficial Midnight port of [Lueur](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/lueur) by Armytille: makes ore, herbs, lumber, quest objects and chests glow as you approach. |

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](https://github.com/lurx/wow-addons/blob/main/LICENSE). Lueur is MIT by Armytille, see [lueur/Lueur/LICENSE](https://github.com/lurx/wow-addons/blob/main/lueur/Lueur/LICENSE).

releases.name: One-Click Mount 1.3.0
releases.notes:
Test build of One-Click Mount for WoW Retail (Midnight).

**Install:** download `OneClickMount-<version>.zip` below, unzip, and put the `OneClickMount` folder in `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/`. Then type `/ocm`, drag your mounts into the rows, and drag the icon at the top right onto your action bar.

**New in 1.3.0**
- EllesmereUI users get a One-Click Mount section in EllesmereUI's own options panel, with the same General and Locations pages and a drag-to-bar button (`/ocm eui` opens it).
- With EllesmereUI, every rule uses an EllesmereUI-style switch in your accent colour, and all text follows your EllesmereUI Global Font (live).
- New icon.
- `/ocm font` prints font details for troubleshooting.

**Since 1.2**
- Optional EllesmereUI skin for the One-Click Mount window.
- Outdoors but mounting not allowed (Trading Post, Lorewalking areas): the button switches to your class speed spell, and back when you leave.
- Mounted on the ground, the button shows your mount and dismounts you.
- "Summon Random Favorite Mount" works in the Flying and Ground rows.

**Highlights**
- One button: class speed spell in combat/indoors, Shift/Ctrl/Alt mounts, Flying where you can fly, Ground elsewhere.
- Special zones: Qiraji tanks in Ahn'Qiraj, the G-99 in Undermine, underwater mounts in Vashj'ir.
- Your own zone rules, random pools, drag-and-drop between slots.

Found a bug? Open an issue with what happened, the output of `/ocm debug`, and any Lua error.
